subject: maths
question:
Study the given pie-chart carefully and answer the following question. 

The entire fund that school gets form different sources is equal to Rs.10 lakh

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2429b91609fa7cb185c54d2bb0dba1f0fa42842b9652e5f45e030f10850b88d8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d104b4096709270d4b448df230f5b29019070b206ebf0d23068c3e0f263ac6.png] 

What amount (in Rs.) of the fund is acquired by the school from internal sources?
solution:
**Given:**

The total fund received by school from different sources = 10 lakh

The school received fund from internal source = 15%

**Concept:**

X\%={Xover100}

**Calculation:**

Let the fund received by internal source is X

⇒ X = 15% of 10 lakh

⇒ X = {15over100}times{1000000}=150000

**∴ The required result will be 150000.**
